text: Agile methodology is a modern way to manage projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, a list of things to do. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs. Every day, the team has a short meeting called a standup to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach helps teams improve their product step by step and respond quickly to changes.
